_readme: Hand-maintained list of scheduled market events (RBI policy, exchange holidays, index rebalancing). Add only dates you have verified from the official source (rbi.org.in, nseindia.com). Format of each entry: { "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "title": "RBI monetary policy decision", "source": "https://www.rbi.org.in" }. The app shows nothing for events that are not listed here and never guesses a date.
